key_insight: SOMA combines sharpness-aware minimization with Muon using stale stochastic gradient noise for perturbations, with sample complexity theoretically invariant to perturbation direction.
engineering_relevance: SOMA targets computationally efficient LLM optimization while exploring resilience to post-training quantization and catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning.
method: Combine sharpness-aware perturbations with Muon's orthogonalized momentum updates.
Reuse stale stochastic gradient noise to construct adversarial perturbations.
Analyze sample complexity and robustness under heavy-tailed gradient noise.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive evaluations of quantization-related quality degradation and catastrophic forgetting, but provides no datasets, model sizes, or numerical results.
watch_item: Verify actual compute savings and sensitivity to stale-noise perturbations at the intended LLM training scale.
